card.name: Metabolic words in warning headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of metabolic words like Fat, Electrolyte and Lipid, mostly in numbered warning section headings (e.g. 5.7 Electrolyte Imbalances) or fat-loss and lipid-monitoring text.

modes.label: Fat in section headings
modes.description: The word Fat starting a numbered heading about fat redistribution.

modes.label: Electrolyte or lipid word pieces
modes.description: The ending piece of Electrolyte or Lipid in headings or monitoring sentences.
